proves.claim: With a batch size of 4, four disjoint accepts give a first job of one item and a second job of the three that waited.

cli.land.batch-forms.why: Without it, a lander that offered each accept at once, ignoring the open land job, would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: Two items changing the same file are never offered in one land job.

cli.land.batch-collision-free.why: Without it, an offer that batched overlapping items would conflict at the merge unnoticed.

proves.claim: With the line settings unset each accept still offers its own land job.

cli.land.batch-defaults-unchanged.why: Without it, a batching change that leaks into the default pace would pass unnoticed.
